# Proto-Persona Template

Copy and fill in this template. Fields marked \* are required — all others are optional but improve simulation quality.

---

## Persona Card

| Field               | Value                                                                     |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Name\***          | _Give the persona a realistic name and role, e.g. "Maria, Fleet Manager"_ |
| **Role / Job**      | _Professional role and company context_                                   |
| **Primary goal\***  | _The #1 thing they want to accomplish with this product_                  |
| **Secondary goals** | _Other things they'd like to do_                                          |

## Demographics & Context

| Field                | Value                                                                                             |
| -------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Age range**        | _e.g. 30–40_                                                                                      |
| **Tech literacy**    | _Low / Medium / High_                                                                             |
| **Domain expertise** | _Novice / Intermediate / Expert in the product's domain_                                          |
| **Device**           | _Desktop / Tablet / Mobile / Mixed_                                                               |
| **Context of use**   | _Where, when, and how they use the product (e.g. "office, multi-monitor", "warehouse on tablet")_ |
| **Connectivity**     | _Reliable / Intermittent / Offline-first_                                                         |

## Behaviours & Attitudes

| Field                         | Value                                                                                     |
| ----------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Motivations**               | _What drives them to use the product (save time, reduce errors, impress stakeholders...)_ |
| **Frustration triggers**      | _What makes them give up or get angry (jargon, slow loading, too many clicks...)_         |
| **Information-seeking style** | _Explores freely / Follows instructions / Searches first / Asks colleagues_               |
| **Risk tolerance**            | _Will try unfamiliar buttons / Only clicks what they understand_                          |
| **Patience level**            | _High (will wait/retry) / Medium / Low (abandons quickly)_                                |

## Accessibility & Constraints

| Field                         | Value                                                                                                  |
| ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **Accessibility needs**       | _Screen reader, magnification, colour-blind mode, motor impairments, cognitive load sensitivity, etc._ |
| **Language**                  | _Primary language, English proficiency level_                                                          |
| **Time pressure**             | _Relaxed / Moderate / Highly time-constrained_                                                         |
| **Environmental constraints** | _Noise, interruptions, lighting, gloves, etc._                                                         |

## Mental Model

| Field            | Value                                                           |
| ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Prior tools**  | _What similar tools have they used before? (sets expectations)_ |
| **Vocabulary**   | _Terms they'd use vs. terms they wouldn't know_                 |
| **Expectations** | _What do they expect the product to look/feel like?_            |

---

## Example: Filled Proto-Persona

| Field                         | Value                                                                                |
| ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **Name**                      | Maria, Fleet Manager                                                                 |
| **Role / Job**                | Operations manager at a logistics company (50 vehicles)                              |
| **Primary goal**              | Quickly assign available vehicles to drivers each morning                            |
| **Secondary goals**           | Monitor vehicle status, export weekly utilisation reports                            |
| **Age range**                 | 35–45                                                                                |
| **Tech literacy**             | Medium — comfortable with Excel and email, unfamiliar with developer tools           |
| **Domain expertise**          | Expert in fleet operations, novice with digital fleet portals                        |
| **Device**                    | Tablet (warehouse) and desktop (office)                                              |
| **Context of use**            | Morning shift in warehouse; noisy, frequently interrupted                            |
| **Connectivity**              | Intermittent wifi in warehouse                                                       |
| **Motivations**               | Reduce admin time, avoid errors that delay drivers                                   |
| **Frustration triggers**      | Unclear jargon, too many steps, slow loading on poor wifi                            |
| **Information-seeking style** | Follows instructions, asks colleagues if stuck                                       |
| **Risk tolerance**            | Only clicks what she understands                                                     |
| **Patience level**            | Low — needs to finish before drivers arrive                                          |
| **Accessibility needs**       | Uses screen magnification at 150%                                                    |
| **Language**                  | German native, business English                                                      |
| **Time pressure**             | Highly time-constrained (30-min window before shifts start)                          |
| **Environmental constraints** | Warehouse noise, interruptions from drivers, sometimes wears gloves                  |
| **Prior tools**               | Paper-based sign-out sheets, basic Excel tracker                                     |
| **Vocabulary**                | "Assign", "sign out", "vehicle list" — not "dispatch queue" or "resource allocation" |
| **Expectations**              | Simple list view, big buttons, clear confirmation                                    |
